MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small metric screw assortments fit my recent interest in fasteners, especially the M2 and M2.5 sizes that complement my M3–M5 kit.",
    "The calipers make sense as tools for sizing screws and washers, although I would wait for a specific measuring need before choosing one."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printer filaments do not follow from my interest in screws and mounting hooks; I have no current printing project.",
    "Heat shrink tubing and solder connectors solve wiring problems, while my recent choices concern fastening and mounting.",
    "The feeler gauge addresses a gap-measuring task I do not have, and a second screw assortment would overlap with the kit I would choose."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hardware seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or DIY supply.",
    "Several filament choices assume that buying small fasteners means I also need 3D printing materials."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection is the specific fastening or mounting purpose, including whether new screw sizes complement supplies I recently chose.",
    "Something can be relevant without being needed now: I rarely interact, and would choose the complementary screw kit while leaving measuring tools for a specific task.",
    "Two similar assortments are alternatives for me, rather than reasons to choose both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in small fasteners but extended it too broadly to unrelated workshop supplies and overlooked my limited immediate needs."
}
